retrievalProfile.description: A stark black layout featuring a small, white-bordered central photograph topped by ultra-thin, overlapping geometric sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: framed central portrait on black background

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition defined by a large black field containing a central, white-framed vertical photograph of a man in a suit, positioned below two tiers of extremely thin, gold-toned geometric sans-serif text that overlaps vertically.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black field vs. framed color photo
Geometric precision of type vs. organic texture of photo
Overlapping letterforms creating a rhythmic pattern
coreInvariants: Thin white border around the image
Hairline stroke weight for all text
Vertical overlap between the two lines of text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical rectangle occupying approximately 40% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central framed photograph acts as the primary weight, while the large text acts as the header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the smaller name to the large title, then resting on the framed portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding all elements, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Solid black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the photo border and upper text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/ochre for the large display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation, warm-toned photograph contrasting with the flat, deep black field.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular 'O' and 'C' forms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' has a deep descent that overlaps the line below
The 'L' and 'E' have long horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different scales and colors.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 1960s aesthetic and circular forms.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black canvas. In the center, place a vertical rectangular photograph with a thin white border. The photo should feature a man in a dark suit in a pensive or melancholic pose within a textured, indoor setting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase geometric sans-serif text above the photo. The top line should be white and small. The second line should be large, gold-toned, and positioned so its top edge overlaps the bottom of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the text stroke weight extremely thin?
Does the large text overlap the line above it?
Is there a thin white border around the central image?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the white border around the photo is uniform and thin.
Verify that the 'Y' or other descenders in the top line interact with the bottom line.
Confirm the black background is solid and noise-free.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black field + centered framed photo + hairline geometric sans-serif stacked with overlap.
